subject: planner: incorrect query result using ISNULL in the nested expressions (#55306)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on planner range extraction via util/ranger. The change correctly preserves NULL single-point intervals when reconstructing merged eq/in conditions by emitting `isnull(col)` instead of `col = NULL` / `in(col, NULL, ...)`, preventing NULL ranges from being dropped. One Blocker/High candidate in this commit (using bitwise `ast.Or` instead of logical `ast.LogicOr` when combining `isnull` with eq/in) was confirmed and then found fixed later on upstream/master by commit 336d3a30f12cf11f10593b7131046c2291a22d4c (#55476), so there is no remaining Blocker/High issue.
